{{Top|leg}}
The '''force bar''' was a [[crowbar]] with a tip that employed a [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibrogenerator]], which provided energy to a vibro-edged head with a stun module. When the vibro-edge was set to maximum it could rip through [[Steel/Legends|steel]] bulkheads easily, and was used for many engineering and repair applications.

It should be noted that force bars were not related to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
